additions.name: TelegramDB
additions.description: Searches indexed Telegram channels, groups and messages by keyword; free Lite tier plus paid credit-based deep search.

additions.name: Lyzem
additions.description: Free search engine for public Telegram channel messages and Telegraph articles, no login required.

additions.name: Telemetrio
additions.description: Telegram channel analytics and ad-intelligence platform with boolean post search across historical and deleted content; freemium with a REST API.
additions.notes: As of Sept 2026 the primary telemetr.io domain intermittently redirects to a temporary tlmtr.io domain; free tier limited to 5 verified channels and 1,000 API requests/month.

additions.name: TGData
additions.description: Searches Telegram messages, channels and groups with a REST API and streaming access; freemium pricing.

additions.name: XCancel
additions.description: Open-source Nitter-fork frontend that lets users view X/Twitter profiles, posts and search results without an account or ads.
additions.notes: Nitter ecosystem is under an X Corp cease-and-desist since Aug 24, 2026; maintainer zedeus secured legal representation Sept 7, 2026 and the project continues, but instance uptime is volatile and the flagship nitter.net has not fully returned.

additions.name: Social Searcher
additions.description: Free, no-login search engine that finds public mentions, hashtags and profiles across major social networks and the open web.

additions.name: Bluesky Search (bskysrch.com)
additions.description: Free advanced query builder for searching Bluesky posts by keyword, hashtag, author and date range.

additions.name: SkySearch
additions.description: Free Bluesky search tool with RSS feed generation for saved queries; installable PWA, public API only, no login.

additions.name: FedSearch
additions.description: Federated search engine indexing public posts across the ActivityPub fediverse (Mastodon and related platforms), free with an API.

additions.name: FediFind
additions.description: Free, no-login search across Mastodon, Bluesky and Flipboard public posts.

additions.name: Tootfinder
additions.description: Free full-text search of opted-in Mastodon posts across the fediverse.
additions.notes: Creator has publicly sought a new maintainer; long-term continuity is at risk as of 2026.

additions.name: Reveddit
additions.description: Free tool that shows Reddit posts and comments removed by moderators or deleted, by reading the live Reddit API.

additions.name: Arctic Shift
additions.description: Free bulk Reddit archive and API covering 2005-present with generous unauthenticated rate limits; full-text search is limited to one subreddit at a time.

additions.name: Academic Torrents Reddit Dataset
additions.description: Free bulk downloadable Reddit posts/comments dataset (2005-2025, ~3.97TB) distributed via BitTorrent for offline research.

additions.name: Xpoz
additions.description: Cross-subreddit natural-language search over Reddit content; freemium with a free tier around 75,000 results.

additions.name: 4chansearch.com
additions.description: Free search engine for indexed 4chan thread and post content.

additions.name: yotsuba-intel
additions.description: Open-source tool and REST API for archiving and searching 4chan threads for OSINT investigations, free.

additions.name: Disboard
additions.description: Free, no-login public directory for finding Discord servers by topic and tag.

additions.name: Disdex
additions.description: Free, no-login index of over 2.5 million public Discord servers, searchable by name and category.

additions.name: Sherlock
additions.description: Free open-source Python CLI that checks a username's existence across 400+ social networks and sites.

additions.name: WhatsMyName App
additions.description: Free, no-login web tool checking username presence across 732+ platforms in parallel, with CSV export; based on the WhatsMyName site-list project.

additions.name: CrotDalam
additions.description: Free open-source Python CLI using a real Chromium browser to search TikTok by keyword and flag scam/phishing content, with evidence screenshots and JSONL/CSV export.
additions.notes: TikTok has no public self-serve search API; this and similar tools work by simulating a warmed browser session and may break when TikTok changes its anti-bot checks.

additions.name: Osintgram
additions.description: Free open-source Python CLI for extracting Instagram followers, hashtags, comments, photos and stories via an unofficial private-API session.
additions.notes: Requires logging in with a real Instagram account, which carries a risk of that account being rate-limited or banned; may break when Instagram changes its private API.

additions.name: yt-dlp
additions.description: Free open-source command-line tool that extracts video, channel, playlist, comment and subtitle metadata from YouTube and other video sites, bypassing the official API's quota and OAuth requirements.

additions.name: Yark
additions.description: Free open-source YouTube archiving tool built for OSINT that preserves metadata for deleted or privatized videos with an offline viewer and timeline notes.

additions.name: Meta Content Library
additions.description: Official Meta researcher-access programme for querying public Facebook and Instagram content and ads; free but requires an application and institutional vetting.
additions.notes: Replaced CrowdTangle (shut down Aug 14, 2024); access requires IRB/institutional approval routed through ICPSR, and researchers widely describe it as far less capable than CrowdTangle.

additions.name: TikTok Research API
additions.description: Official TikTok programme giving vetted academic researchers query access to public video and comment metadata; free but application-gated.

additions.name: TikTok Commercial Content Library
additions.description: Official TikTok ad-transparency tool and API built for EU DSA Article 39 compliance, covering paid commercial content served in the EEA.
additions.notes: The European Commission found TikTok's ad repository non-compliant with DSA Art. 39 (May 15, 2025); TikTok accepted binding Article 71 commitments (Dec 5, 2025) to fix search filters and update latency, not yet implemented as of Sept 2026.

additions.name: Google Ads Transparency Center
additions.description: Free, browser-only tool for searching verified advertisers' ads served on Search, YouTube and Display, including an EU DSA disclosure layer.
additions.notes: No official query API; browser search only.

additions.name: LinkedIn Ad Library
additions.description: Free, browser-only search of LinkedIn ads by advertiser or keyword with country/date filters and EU impression ranges.
additions.notes: No official API; browser search only.

additions.name: Kick Keyword Search (kickchatlogs.com)
additions.description: Free search of archived Kick.com chat messages, videos, usernames and channel slugs with boolean and proximity operators.

changes.name: Nitter
changes.detail: X Corp issued a cease-and-desist against the Nitter project on Aug 24, 2026, taking most public instances offline; maintainer zedeus secured legal representation and announced the project continues on Sept 7, 2026, but flagship nitter.net has not fully returned and instance availability remains volatile.

changes.name: Pushshift
changes.detail: Public API access was revoked in May 2023 after Reddit's API pricing changes; access is now restricted to verified subreddit moderators only and is not available for general OSINT use.

changes.name: PullPush
changes.detail: The Pushshift-replacement API stopped ingesting new Reddit data around May 2025 and has since suffered repeated outages (HTTP 502s in July 2026, HTTP 429 refusals in Aug 2026), making it effectively unreliable for current research.

changes.name: Unddit / Camas
changes.detail: Both Reddit deleted-comment viewers are dead; their domains no longer resolve.

changes.name: Removeddit
changes.detail: The domain has been hijacked and now redirects to an unrelated online casino affiliate site; use Reveddit instead.

changes.name: CrowdTangle
changes.detail: Meta shut down CrowdTangle on August 14, 2024; its official replacement, the Meta Content Library, requires institutional/IRB vetting and is widely described by former users as retaining only a small fraction of CrowdTangle's features.

changes.name: TweetDeck / X Pro
changes.detail: On March 26, 2026, X moved X Pro (formerly free TweetDeck) from being included with the $8/month Premium plan to being locked behind the $40/month Premium+ tier, a fivefold price increase applied without advance notice; X has signaled X Pro will eventually be replaced by a new tool.

changes.name: Facebook Graph Search
changes.detail: Native Facebook Graph Search has been dead since 2019; most 'people who like X'-style queries no longer work, though some manually crafted combined-attribute search URLs (e.g. via graph.tips) still partially function as of 2026.

changes.name: X Ads Repository
changes.detail: X publishes only downloadable CSV files for its DSA-mandated ad repository, with no query API; the European Commission fined X EUR 120 million on Dec 5, 2025 partly over this repository's unreliable search and failures to grant researcher data access under DSA Art. 40(12).

changes.name: TikTok Ad Repository
changes.detail: Found non-compliant with DSA Art. 39 on May 15, 2025; TikTok accepted binding Article 71 commitments on Dec 5, 2025 to add full ad content/URLs, faster updates and expanded search filters over 2-12 months, but as of Sept 2026 these fixes had not yet been implemented.

changes.name: OSINT Combine free tools
changes.detail: OSINT Combine's free-tools page is now primarily a curated bookmark directory pointing to third-party tools and its own paid NexusXplore platform, rather than a set of hosted standalone free tools.
